async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Search for the article
    search_box = page.get_by_role("search").get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    await search_box.fill("Downing Street insists negotiations over US-UK tech deal still live")
    search_button = page.get_by_role("search").get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Find and click the article link
    # Assuming the search results contain a link with the article title
    article_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Downing Street insists negotiations over US-UK tech deal still live", exact=False)
    await article_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Extract images from the article page
    # Get the current URL after navigation
    current_url = page.url
    # Use relative URL by extracting path
    from urllib.parse import urlparse
    parsed_url = urlparse(current_url)
    relative_url = parsed_url.path + ("?" + parsed_url.query if parsed_url.query else "")
    
    # Call the knowledge base function
    result = await extract_images_from_page_manual(page, relative_url)
    # Return the result as-is
    return result
